question: Can the embedding neighbourhood resolve the 630 claims left on the Nimitz node?
answer: NO. Nothing was applied to the graph. The 630 remain NOT ESTABLISHED.

claim_text_vs_event_node_NAME.easy_gold: 57.6% top-1 over the 342 claims re-pointed by reading today
claim_text_vs_event_node_NAME.realistic_gold: 19.5% top-1 over 400 claims attached to an event they do NOT name
claim_text_vs_event_node_NAME.null_distribution: random claim/event pairs: mean 0.383, sd 0.065, p99 0.564, max 0.598
claim_text_vs_event_node_NAME.verdict: unusable - a short name against prose is the weak form of the comparison

kNN_over_claim_TEXT.realistic_gold: 75.3% top-1, and 91.4% precision at 63% recall with a 0.60 vote share
kNN_over_claim_TEXT.verdict: looked usable, and IS NOT - see the bias below

why_the_91_percent_does_not_transfer: The validation population was claims ALREADY correctly attached to an event. A claim is only in that population because its true event had other claims - otherwise nothing would have attached it correctly in the first place. So the answer was guaranteed present in its own neighbourhood. The 630 are the opposite case: 59% of event nodes hold fewer than 3 claims and 237 hold none, and Socorro held ZERO until this morning. When the true event is sparse, kNN cannot vote for it and votes for the nearest well-populated event instead. Same bias structure as the merge-ledger corpus: a validation set drawn from cases where the method already worked.

measured_on_the_actual_target.so: 40% wrong wherever an independent check exists, against a promised 91.4%
worked_examples: 17 claims assigned to 'Aveyron case' are about a 1962 Verona observation and the Delphos Kansas encounter - grouped by PHYSIOLOGICAL AFTER-EFFECTS, not by event
13 assigned to Roswell are about Takala cables, Westall and the Deadhorse shoot-down
one assigned to Kaikoura names JAL Flight 1628; two assigned elsewhere name Westall
measured_on_the_actual_target.clusters_that_WERE_right: 1952 Washington DC flap (9), 1967 Malmstrom (9), 1991 North West Cape (14) - all events that already held claims, which is the point

what_the_method_actually_measures: Topic similarity, not event identity. 'A witness suffered numbness after a close encounter' is near-identical prose whichever event it describes. That is not a tuning problem and no threshold fixes it.
what_would_change_the_answer: Seeding the sparse events. Socorro went from 0 claims to 39 today by reading, and it is now findable by neighbourhood where it was invisible before. A second kNN pass AFTER more events carry claims would do better than this one - the instrument improves as the graph does, so this is worth re-running later rather than abandoning.
not_done: No claim was moved. 630 stay marked NOT ESTABLISHED on the Nimitz node.
